question: What mental act constitutes the sin-effacing practice described here?
premises: The sin-person is the object of contemplation.
The contemplation presents him as crushed.
This visualization is identified as aghamarṣaṇa.
inference: Aghamarṣaṇa consists in visualizing the sin-person as crushed.
plain_english: One should visualize the sin-man as crushed; this is the sin-effacing practice.
